rules.promotion: Only reviewed passing candidates; no automatic promotion
rules.evidence: Retain every command, return code, elapsed time, generator record, output hash, review sheet and rejection reason
rules.judgment: Missing listening or visual evidence remains unreviewed, never passed

cases.brief: A complete scrapyard magnet pickup, normalized to 0.5 metres tall with floor origin.
review: Complete front and invented back, no hollow shell or disconnected debris
Readable pickup silhouette from the angled arena camera
Height 0.5 m within 1%; lowest Y within 1 mm; valid GLB and truthful records

cases.brief: A rigged scrapyard robot rusher using the humanoid profile, 1.8 metres tall.
review: Closed head and torso; one limb per side; no lifted floor
Export and rig gates pass with no record edits
Review front/back/side poses and hands on the actual body

cases.brief: One idle loop, one forward run, and one forward melee swipe for the actual rusher body.
review: Each action reads correctly on the body, not only on the stick sheet
Idle has no unintended travel; run feet contact the floor
Swipe is a single readable action; no persistent limb/body penetration
Full audit and manifest checks pass

cases.brief: A single short mechanical sci-fi rifle shot, immediate sharp attack, metallic body, short clean decay. No speech, music or background noise.
review: Matches a rifle shot rather than ambience or several shots
Tail ends without a click or an abrupt low-frequency cutoff

cases.brief: Instrumental scrapyard sci-fi arena combat loop, driving industrial percussion and gritty synth bass at 120 BPM. Consistent energy, no vocals, no intro, no fadeout.
review: Listen across repeated loop joins for rhythmic or harmonic discontinuity
A level-matched seam alone does not prove a seamless musical loop

cases.brief: Original designed adult scavenger voice, clear and urgent, speaking: Hold the scrap line.
review: Exact words intelligible with no babble or added speech
No silence/clipping, natural timing and complete word endings
cases.known_blocker: Pinned MOSS-TTS runtime previously produced silence/babble under host transformers 5; do not label supported from doctor or designed-voice success alone.
